faq.q: Is there a metro system in GTA 6?
faq.a: Yes. A metro system appears in official trailer material, with at least one station identifiable in shots of Vice City.

faq.q: Can players ride the Vice City Metro?
faq.a: Not known. Press coverage confirms the metro's visual presence but notes that Rockstar has not clarified whether it will function as rideable transit, a fast-travel option, or background set dressing.

faq.q: What is the Vice City Metro based on?
faq.a: Its real-world basis is the Miami-Dade Metrorail and Metromover system.

faq.q: How many stations does the Vice City Metro have?
faq.a: The record confirms at least one station visible in trailer footage, but a full station count is not given.

notKnown: Whether the metro is rideable, a fast-travel tool, or purely background set dressing.

howWeKnow: ScreenRant's location breakdown of official GTA 6 trailer material confirmed the visual presence of a metro system in Vice City. Rockstar has shown the system on screen but has not clarified its gameplay role, so this record is press-reported rather than fully confirmed.
